scenarios.scenario: A fail-open auth change is made without exercising absent, malformed, expired, and fallback-secret tokens.
scenarios.rationale: The mandatory isolated runner and generated-JWT fixture do not exist in this environment, so this attack path cannot be proven safe.

scenarios.scenario: A rejected foreign-order slip upload writes an object before ownership is checked.
scenarios.rationale: No fake or disposable storage spy exists, so the mandatory no-write assertion cannot be run.

scenarios.scenario: The live smoke script mutates a remote system during verification.
scenarios.rationale: test_smoke.ts was not run and no HTTP request or provider call was made.
